name: sentop-link
description: ChatGPT connector for Sentop Link: explain what it does, answer FAQs, and list your own meetings.

interface.longDescription:
Sentop Link is an AI-powered video meeting and business communication platform by Sentop Solution Limited (UK).

What Sentop Link does:
• Video meetings — HD video, screen sharing, waiting room, in-meeting chat, recording, webinars and virtual backgrounds.
• Live transcription and AI meeting minutes — automatic notes, summaries and action items.
• Real-time translation — translate meeting speech as text and as audio across many languages, live during the meeting.
• Live captions — real-time on-screen captions for accessibility.
• AI phone receptionist (AI Secretary) — answers your business phone, understands speech, answers questions and can book meetings automatically, including capturing missed calls and sending a meeting invite.
• Business phone numbers, calls, IVR menus and SMS in many countries.

This connector can: describe what Sentop Link does and answer common factual questions (no account needed), and — when you sign in — list your own Sentop Link meetings. It does not perform in-meeting actions. Multiple currencies are supported, with GBP as the base currency; UK GDPR aligned (ICO registration ZC194912). Learn more at https://sentop.link.
capabilities: Explain what Sentop Link does: meetings, transcription, minutes, translation, captions, AI receptionist, phone and SMS.
Answer FAQs about supported languages, security and UK GDPR, setup, and how the AI receptionist books meetings.
List the signed-in user's own Sentop Link meetings (requires sign-in; own data only).
defaultPrompt: What can Sentop Link do for multilingual meetings?
How does the Sentop Link AI receptionist book meetings?

positive.description: Describe the product with no account
positive.expected_behavior: Return a factual overview of Sentop Link's features (video meetings, transcription, AI minutes, translation, captions, AI receptionist, phone/SMS) without requiring sign-in.

positive.description: Answer a factual FAQ about translation
positive.prompt: How does Sentop Link's real-time translation work?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a factual explanation of the real-time translation feature from the FAQ, without requiring sign-in.

positive.prompt: Is Sentop Link secure and GDPR compliant?
positive.expected_behavior: Return factual information about security and UK GDPR alignment (ICO registration ZC194912), without requiring sign-in.
After OAuth sign-in, return only the signed-in reviewer account's own meetings (title, date/time, status, link). Returns no other users' data.

positive.prompt: Show only my upcoming Sentop Link meetings.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, return only the reviewer account's scheduled/upcoming meetings, excluding ended ones.
